12 question presented, the only issue is whether Bay Mills

20 the State's exclusive jurisdiction.
21 Second, a tribe should not have greater
22 immunity than foreign nations. There's no dispute that,
23 if France opened up an illegal business in Michigan,
24 casino or otherwise, it would have no blanket immunity.
